entries.title: Psalms 82:1
segments: ¶<<A Psalm of Asaph.>> God stands in the congregation of the mighty; He judges among the gods.

entries.title: Psalms 82:2
segments: How long will you judge unjustly, And show partiality to the wicked? Selah

entries.title: Psalms 82:3
segments: Defend the poor and fatherless; Do justice to the afflicted and needy.

entries.title: Psalms 82:4
segments: Deliver the poor and needy; Free [them] from the hand of the wicked.

entries.title: Psalms 82:5
segments: They do not know, nor do they understand; They walk about in darkness; All the foundations of the earth are unstable.

entries.title: Psalms 82:6
segments: ¶I said, "You [are] gods, And all of you [are] children of the Most High.

entries.title: Psalms 82:7
segments: But you shall die like men, And fall like one of the princes."

entries.title: Psalms 82:8
segments: Arise, O God, judge the earth; For You shall inherit all nations.
